handoffs.title: 142 West 88th Street move-out
handoffs.nextStep: Key deficiencies from the 2018-03-01 move-out walk-through include unsafe SE bedroom loft-ladder railing, widespread floor damage/staining with urine odor, damaged woodwork/mantels/window sills, plaster/ceiling damage, torn stair runner and stained office carpet, broken NE bedroom door, and bathroom finish damage. Owner wants Feld Architecture to assess/scope first (excluding kitchen water repair), while immediately making the loft-ladder railing safe. Owner has set aside $65,000 for move-out restoration, separate from any deposit/accounting.
